b: I've been walking for 1.5 hours every evening. No phone, no music, no podcasts, no headphones. Just walking.
It's crazy how peaceful it feels. My head gets clear, I feel much calmer, and I sleep better. It's also nice to have some time away from screens and all the noise of everyday life.
At first, 1.5 hours might sound like a lot, but now I actually look forward to it every evening.
Honestly, it's like a cheat code for relaxing your nervous system.
